name: @fleetvision/mdvr-streamer-service
description: FleetVision MDVR live-video media plane — receives Meitrack binary 0x12 media packets on the video TCP port (device dialback after A9A), reassembles H.264/H.265 access units, transcodes them through ffmpeg to low-latency MPEG-TS, and broadcasts the TS bytes to browser players over a binary WebSocket (JSMpeg).
